# Harbor Clinic front-desk workstation

You are hardening HC-FRONTDESK-0417, a Windows 11 workstation at the Harbor Clinic reception desk. It is shared by the front-desk staff and must stay usable for check-in.

Authorized administrators are alice and bob only. Remove every other member of the local Administrators group.

The built-in Guest account must be disabled.

Remote Desktop must stay disabled on this workstation.

The Print Spooler service must keep running, because the front desk prints patient check-in forms with it.

Forensic question 1: which local account was created after the image was built, and who created it?
